title: Registered predictions: vacuum density from the atomic-hydrogen cooling threshold (release normalization)
theory: Entropic Scalar EFT, Appendix O (release of committed capacity on irreversible baryonic mixing); omega_Lambda = eta_* omega_c^wb I_rel with eta_* = 0.0298668, omega_c^wb = 5.333 omega_b
inputs_not_adjusted_to_Lambda: mixing kernels measured in the 2026-10-04 Gadget-4 run (K0 0.53-0.70, f 2.2-4.9)
retention gate from t_cool = t_dyn for primordial atomic cooling

V1_Omega_Lambda.value: 0.67-0.74 for retention gates 12-17 km/s (rho_Lambda within -14% / +16% of the required value)
V1_Omega_Lambda.falsifier: a feedback-resolved, converged zoom that reads the gate from gas retention and returns I_rel outside 85-105 (gate outside about 12.5-17 km/s)

V2_minimum_retaining_halo.value: halos below about 5e7 Msun at z ~ 10 (V_vir < 14 km/s, T_vir < 1.4e4 K neutral) retain no mixed gas carrying source records
V2_minimum_retaining_halo.test: faint-end turnover of the z ~ 8-12 UV luminosity function, reionization history, 21-cm
V2_minimum_retaining_halo.falsifier: galaxies retaining mixed, record-carrying gas in halos well below 5e7 Msun at z ~ 10

caveats: kernel from a low-resolution SPH run (~1e3 gas particles per host) without feedback or H2
premises O.1-O.15 (fixed event measure, rho_Lambda,i = 0, common conversion, record identification)
label definition moves I_rel by about +-20% at the reference gate (2026-10-04)
